issues.on_page: Line 15 Transfers In Of Surplus Fees 71,682.01; line 16 Transfer In Other Than Surplus Fees blank; line 28 Transfers Out Other Than Surplus Fees 71,682.01
issues.issue: The form puts the transfer in on line 15 (surplus fees) but the transfer out on line 28 (other than surplus fees, which should agree with line 16). The amounts match and the p2 Documentation of Transfers (49,999.99 + 21,682.02) supports 71,682.01, so the figures are fine; only the line placement on the form is inconsistent.

p2 calls this a grant for an ambulance purchase. Without a stated source, state aid is a reasonable choice, but it is 38% of the year's receipts. It may be a one-time capital grant (or federal pass-through), so it's worth a quick look.
